blocks.text: K-pop boy band Stray Kids has chosen not to submit music for consideration at next year’s 2027 Grammy Awards, joining BTS in sitting out the awards amid controversy over a newly created category for Asian pop music. The band’s label, JYP Entertainment, said Friday, Oct. 2, that Stray Kids did not submit any music for the 69th Grammy Awards, according to Billboard and the BBC. The company did not elaborate on the reason for the decision. The move came shortly after the Recording Academy reaffirmed that it would go ahead with its new Best Asian Pop Music Performance category at next […]...
